During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''smuggler'''<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> allied to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]<ref name="Alliance" /> infiltrated an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] outpost with several other Rebels, including an [[Unidentified Ewok (Alliance)|Ewok]]. The smuggler and their fellows disguised themselves as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], but the Ewok was more difficult to disguise. The smuggler devised a solution by disguising the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] as an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]].<ref name="RPG" />
